title: manifest.json
description: The record file of one compilation: which specification it was made under, who and what made it, how, and one entry per book file.

specification.description: The specification this compilation was produced under.

file.description: The specification file's path in the repository, for example specifications/<ULID>.yaml.

sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the specification file, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

statement.description: Exactly: This compilation was produced under Open Lexis Transcription Specification <ULID>.

license.description: The specification's license, copied unchanged from its license field.

id.description: The compilation's ULID; it is also the name of its folder.

title.description: A title a reader can relate to.

subtitle.description: A short subtitle summarizing the model or approach.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences summarizing the compilation.

author.description: The publisher of the compilation, for example Open Lexis.

createdAt.description: When the compilation was made, as an ISO 8601 date and time, for example 2026-11-25T00:00:00.000Z.

outputDirectory.description: Where the compilation was written, normally transcripts/<specification ULID>/<compilation ULID>/.

modelAttribution.description: The system or model that made the judgments (selecting readings and estimating probabilities). Write unknown for anything the model could not observe about itself; never guess.

provider.description: The lab or company that made the model.

versionSnapshot.description: The exact version or release snapshot, if known.

variant.description: The variant or tier, if any.

effortLevel.description: The reasoning or effort setting the model ran at, exactly as the harness names it (for example: medium).

harness.description: The harness or runtime the model ran in.

role.description: What the model designed and decided.

note.description: Any other relevant note about the attribution.

deterministicEngine.description: The deterministic program that copied, parsed and formatted the data, if one was used.

program.description: The program's path, for example scripts/compile.ts.

commit.description: The git commit the program ran at.

codeSha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the program's code.

summary.description: One or two sentences summarizing the method.

scenarios.description: Optional scenarios and how each was treated.

differenceCategories.description: Optional kinds of difference and what each means.

unknownsAndLimitations.description: Optional list of unknowns and limitations.

disagreementCategories.description: Optional: the categories of mechanical difference the model used, with counts. The model chooses its own categories.

totals.description: Totals across all books; each must equal the sum over books.

variantPlaces.description: Number of points of disagreement (<app> elements).

totalBytes.description: Total size of the book files in bytes.

books.description: One entry per target book of the specification, in the specification's order.

id.description: The book's short id, for example Gen.

name.description: The book's name, for example Genesis.

number.description: The book's position in the canon order, starting at 1.

language.description: The book's original language, for example Hebrew and Aramaic.

file.description: The book's TEI file name: <book id>.xml.

sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the book's TEI file.

bytes.description: Size of the book's TEI file in bytes.

early.description: How many of those are early.

meanPlaceConfidence.description: Average probability of the selected reading at points of disagreement, 0 to 1.

meanWordConfidence.description: Average probability per compiled word, 0 to 1.

meanManuscriptsPerLine.description: Average number of manuscripts covering a line.

categoryCounts.description: Optional: count per disagreement category id.

severityCounts.description: Optional: count per disagreement subcategory id.

copyright.description: The copyright line, for example Copyright 2026 Open Lexis.

name.description: The license name, for example CC BY-NC 4.0.
